v.why: Stacking 3x3 after 3x3 saturates the receptive field and makes optimization harder.
A 1x1 upstream leaves receptive-field room for a 3x3 to add spatial context.
Spatial context is missing after a 1x1, so the 3x3 contributes more.
A learned 3x3 after a parameter-free pool adds missing learnable capacity.
A skip upstream leaves the chain with no spatial mixing, so a 3x3 adds more.
An avg_pool sibling at node 3 blurs the sum, so the extra conv on edge 5 contributes less.
A pooled sibling dilutes feature scale at node 3, damping the gain from a conv.
A pooled sibling at node 3 mixes smoothed features, making the conv on edge 3 less distinctive.
A pooled sibling at node 2 dilutes the contribution of a conv on edge 1.

raw:
These ten avoid the dead-edge and skip-redundancy arguments that most models would propose first. They rest instead on how the parent op shapes feature quality (pooling, 1x1, skip, chained 3x3) and on sibling interactions.
